intro.text: An aging Arelene duke and one of the richest men in Arelon, a veteran politician who helped King Iadon to power but quietly backed Prince Raoden against him.
An aging Arelene duke and one of Arelon's richest men, whom Sarene and her allies are backing for the throne over Duke Telrii by way of a political marriage to Sarene.

items.text: Roial's wife, Eoldess, died ten years before the Reod.

Before the Reod, Roial governed the port city of Iald, and afterwards he was the only official installed by the Elantrians to stay in power. He helped Iadon become king and steady his new rule, but came to feel guilty for the damage Iadon's system did to Arelon, and in private he supported Prince Raoden against his father.

With Raoden gone, his circle of allies mostly fell apart, but Roial agreed to one last meeting at Kiin's house. There he met Princess Sarene, who soon took the lead of the group, and he and Kiin agreed she could unite them in Raoden's place.
Roial's holdings included Iald, the country's second-richest city, which made him one of the wealthiest men in Arelon; King Iadon only stayed ahead by counting the nation's taxes as his own income.
At Sarene's request, Roial held an eclipse-viewing ball at his house, where he chided her for withdrawing from the group's affairs and warned that Dilaf might cause trouble.
With the throne at stake, Shuden proposed that Sarene marry Roial so that their pooled wealth could carry his claim over Telrii's, and the two agreed.

Roial treated Sarene kindly and promised her the marriage would be political only; since he expected to die within a few years, she could then wed a younger man. At the wedding, however, Hrathen's poison made Sarene seem taken by the Shaod. She was cast into Elantris, and Telrii became king.
When Sarene came back out of Elantris, Roial and the other lords were waiting for her at the gate. After a brief exchange with Hrathen, the group returned to Kiin's house.

As the group met at Kiin's house to plan against King Telrii, Count Ahan slipped away and returned with Telrii and his guards, gloating that he had finally bested Roial. Telrii had Roial killed for treason. Raoden tried to heal him but failed, and the duke died.
Roial was buried among those who had fought for Arelon, alongside Eondel, Karata and Saolin.

appearance.text: Roial is a very plain old man, thin and small, with locks of powder-white hair; he is old enough to be Sarene's father or even her grandfather.

personality.text: Rather than dignified and reserved, Roial is loud and impish, and dominates any conversation despite his slight frame. Rich as he is, he lives frugally, except for his lavish gardens, which he adores and often strolls through.
A shrewd merchant, Roial has made himself the second or third wealthiest man in Arelon.
